newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Shares respond to earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCK HIGHLIGHTS - Shares respond to earnings.

text.p: Company posted fourth quarter earnings of $0.56 a share, beating the Wall Street consensus of $0.34 a share. Several brokerage firms upgraded ratings on the stock.
Reported an on-target second quarter but analysts cited some disappointing elements. Investors are nervous that Gateway's inventory build-up is a signal that PC demand is slowing, analysts said.
GALILEO INTERNATIONAL INC GLC.N up 1-9/16 to 26-1/16/
Initial public offering of electronic reservation company.
MEMC ELECTRONIC MATERIALS INC tumbled 8-7/8 to 29-5/8.
Second quarter earnings fell to $0.09 a share, including a one-time gain of $0.08, from $1.12 a year ago. J.P. Morgan Securities and First Boston downgraded the stock.
FIREARMS TRAINING SYSTEMS INC dropped 5-1/4 to 7-1/8.
Said operating income in its fiscal year 1998 could drop between 25 to 40 percent due to delays in U.S. military orders.
Posted rised in second quarter earnings to $0.22 a share from $0.19 a year ago.
Posted second quarter earnings of $0.19 a share, rebounding from a loss of $0.39 a share a year earlier. Bear Stearns upgraded the stock to buy from neutral.
Reported second earnings from operations of $0.25 a share, up from $0.21 a year ago. Alex. Brown upgraded the stock to buy from market perform.
